screens.screen: home (الرئيسية): 7-tile menu grid + cash-fund account cards

notes: Colours from color_manager.dart / app_themes.dart (Material 3, primary #354276, accent #E56510, card #E8EAF0). App ships no custom font, so the system font (SF / SF Arabic) is used. Scaffold background is ColorScheme.fromSeed(white).surface, approximated as #F7F9FD. Currency is the rial sign glyph and 'ريال' exactly as the code prints them (model default currency is YER), amounts use the app's #,##0 format. Sample data is consistent: the three fund accounts on home are the leaves under 'الصندوق' in the tree, balance = revenue - expenses, each invoice net = total - discount. The account-statement and invoice-details screens were not chosen because both are horizontally scrolling 8/4-column DataTables that are cut off on a phone; they would look clipped in a still image.
